<style id="paia-refinement-palette">/* Review candidate: neutral content planes, blue only for emphasis.
   Applied to the existing approved prototypes; no new product structure. */
:root{--ink:#222832;--text:#343b45;--muted:#616b78;--quiet:#687381;--soft:#687381;--blue:#3769c9;--blue-deep:#2e5fba;--line:#e1e6ec;--line-soft:#edf0f3;--surface:#fff;--paper:#fff;--tint:#f1f5fb;--hover:#f5f7fa;--selected:#edf3ff;--focus:#5a85ca;--shadow:0 14px 40px #24314616;--canvas:#fff}
html{background:var(--paper)}
body:not([data-theme=dark]),body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.app,.main){background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.sidebar,.navigator){background:#fcfdff;border-color:#e5eaf0}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.brand,.page-title,.nav-title,.reader-title,.results-title,.doc-title){color:#242d3b}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.navitem,.group-link,.project-toggle,.conversation-link,.conversation-link>.ico,.project-toggle>.folder,.group-link .ico,.sort-button,.icon-button,.aa-button){color:#5c6674}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.navitem.active,.nav-item.active,.group-link[aria-current=page],.conversation-link[aria-current=page]){color:#305eac;background:#edf3ff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #dce7fa}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.sidebar .navitem:hover,.project-toggle:hover,.conversation-link:hover,.group-link:hover){background:#f2f5f9}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.topic-card,.context-card,.compact-card,.paper,.reading-preview,.conflict-version,.example-document){background:#fff;border-color:#e0e6ee;box-shadow:0 5px 13px -10px #192f572c}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.topic-card:hover,.context-card:hover,.compact-card:hover){background:#fff;border-color:#c9d7ea;box-shadow:0 10px 24px -17px #233f6a40}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.topic-title,.card-title,.group-title,.detail-title,.row-name,.entry-title,.section-heading,.doc-description,.topic-row-title,.modal-head h2,.drawer-head h2,.modal h2,.drawer h2,.read-title,.paper h3,.option strong,.source-body.current){color:#2b3543}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.input-body,.entry-text,.item-body,.result-text,.result-excerpt,.ai-stage p,.ai-lead,.read-chapter p,.version p,.conflict-version p,.legal,.source-body,.basis-box){color:#343b45}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.chapter-link,.chapter-name,.quote-text,.compact-title,.peek-line,.context-directory-link,.context-directory-link .ico,.topic-row-desc,.content-group>.group-label,.toc-button,.result-top){color:#525e6d}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.page-subtitle,.page-subtitle span,.subtitle,.card-description,.eyebrow,.section-label,.quiet-label,.toolbar-title,.toolbar-title small,.breadcrumb,.breadcrumb-current,.crumb-current,.reader-meta,.pathline,.record-time,.day-head,.record-note,.record-note button,.source-link,.source-link span,.item-status,.item-meta,.group-intro,.row-note,.row-value,.row-value .ico,.caption,.local-status,.gate-caption,.detail-copy,.entry-detail,.card-count,.topic-end,.topic-end .ico,.toc-caption,.toc-eyebrow,.back,.back-row,.back-row button,.search-label,.search-box input::placeholder,.nav-search input::placeholder,.find-box input::placeholder,.nav-foot,.attachment-note,.result-path,.result-date,.results-subtitle,.result-kind,.reader-end,.doc-end,.subtle-footer,.notice-footer,.hint,.hint .ico,.paper p,.modal p,.source-data,.source-data dd,.source-caption,.drawer p,.drawer-bottom small,.basis-note,.read-subtitle,.detail-foot,.detail-foot span,.group-footer,.preview-footnote,.scope-note){color:#687381}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.topic-symbol,.card-symbol,.topic-row-symbol,.support-icon,.symbol){color:#6183b3;background:#f7faff;border-color:#e3ebf6}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.search-box,.nav-search,.find-box,.value-select,.pref-row select,.modal input:not([type=checkbox]),.modal select){background:#fff;border-color:#dfe5ed;box-shadow:0 2px 7px #1f345005;color:#4f5a69}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.drawer,.modal,.context-menu,.popover){background:#fff;border-color:#dfe5ed;box-shadow:0 18px 65px #172a4520}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.source-body,.basis-box,.data-line,.preview-group){background:#fbfcfe;border-color:#e2e7ee}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.input-body:focus,.item-body:focus,.edit-area:focus){background:#fff;border-color:#a9c3e7;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #edf3fc}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.input-body:hover,.item-body:hover){background:#fafbfc}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.card-foot,.card-footer,.chapter-list,.quote-link,.entry,.doc-control,.reader-toolbar,.topic-toolbar,.settings-rows,.row,.entry-list,.search-results,.result,.day-head:after,.drawer-head,.drawer-bottom,.content-group){border-color:#e8ecf1}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.text-button,.ghost,.open-topic,.preview-trigger,.connection-link,.context-directory-link:hover,.chapter-link:hover,.source-link:hover,.back:hover,.back-row button:hover,.toc-button.active,.topic-row-title:hover){color:#3566b6}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.gate,.gate[data-paused=true]){color:#5e6c7d;background:#fff;border-color:#dce3ed}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) .gate[aria-checked=true]{color:#3566b6;background:#f5f8ff;border-color:#d7e5fb}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.view-switch button.selected,.filters button[aria-pressed=true],.option.selected){color:#3566b6;background:#edf3ff;border-color:#d9e5f8}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.view-switch,.filters){background:#f6f8fb;border-color:#e3e8ef}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.primary,.button-primary){background:#3769c9;color:#fff}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.secondary,.button-secondary){background:#fff;color:#53647b;border-color:#dce3ed}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.danger,.danger-button,.button-danger){color:#a14452}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.danger-button,.button-danger){background:#aa4f5c;color:#fff}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.inline-note.error,.save-state.error){color:#9b3e50;background:#fff7f8;border-color:#ead4d9}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.transient-notice,.paused-note,.inline-note){background:#f7faff;color:#5f6f84;border-color:#e0e8f4}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) .input-body.code{background:#f8fafc;color:#354352}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) mark{background:#e6efff;color:#2f5690}
/* The same role system in dark; this is not a blue-tinted full-screen theme. */
body[data-theme=dark]{--ink:#edf0f5;--text:#d7dde5;--muted:#a2afc0;--quiet:#a2afc0;--soft:#a2afc0;--blue:#92b7f4;--line:#35414f;--line-soft:#2d3744;--surface:#202731;--paper:#1a2028;--hover:#2b3542;--canvas:#1a2028;background:#1a2028;color:#edf0f5}
body[data-theme=dark] :is(.app,.main){background:#1a2028}
body[data-theme=dark] :is(.sidebar,.navigator){background:#1c232d;border-color:#35414f}
body[data-theme=dark] :is(.topic-card,.context-card,.compact-card,.paper,.drawer,.modal,.popover,.context-menu,.conflict-version){background:#202731;border-color:#35414f;box-shadow:none}
body[data-theme=dark] :is(.entry-text,.item-body,.input-body,.source-body,.read-chapter p,.ai-stage p,.result-text,.result-excerpt,.legal,.conflict-version p){color:#d7dde5}
body[data-theme=dark] :is(.page-title,.brand,.doc-title,.card-title,.topic-title,.section-heading,.group-title,.detail-title,.row-name,.reader-title,.nav-title){color:#edf0f5}
body[data-theme=dark] :is(.chapter-link,.quote-text,.context-directory-link,.toc-button,.navitem,.row-value,.card-description,.record-time,.reader-meta,.source-link,.pathline,.subtitle,.page-subtitle,.section-label,.group-label,.record-note,.gate-caption){color:#a9b6c7}
body[data-theme=dark] :is(.navitem.active,.nav-item.active,.toc-button.active,.group-link[aria-current=page],.conversation-link[aria-current=page]){background:#293f5e;color:#c2d8fa;border-color:#3f587a;box-shadow:none}
body[data-theme=dark] :is(.nav-search,.search-box,.find-box,.value-select,.pref-row select){background:#242e3b;border-color:#3b485b;color:#d2deee}
body[data-theme=dark] :is(.gate,.topic-symbol,.card-symbol,.symbol){background:#263449;color:#b4ccec;border-color:#3b516e}
body[data-theme=dark] :is(.input-body:focus,.item-body:focus,.edit-area:focus){background:#26313f;border-color:#7ea4d9;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #344a66}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) .context-card::before{opacity:.18}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) .topic-card::before{opacity:.25}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) .card-symbol::before{background:#f7faff;border-color:#e7edf6;transform:none}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) .search-box input::placeholder,body:not([data-theme=dark]) .nav-search input::placeholder,body:not([data-theme=dark]) .find-box input::placeholder{color:#687381}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.small-more,.more-btn,.provider-heading,.toolbar-note,.card-footer .open-topic){color:#687381}
body:not([data-theme=dark]) :is(.open-topic:hover,.small-more:hover,.more-btn:hover){color:#3566b6}
body[data-theme=dark] :is(.context-card::before,.topic-card::before){opacity:0}
</style>
